candidate_a: first k of the query's interests known, k in 0..3; the rest omitted
normalization: each known property's bound facts divided by their L2 norm; no sign threshold

influence.pairs: same person; query knows its first n_q interests, candidate its first n_c; age, job, region known
influence.share: interests' contribution t_int(q).t_int(c)/(|h_q||h_c|) divided by the cosine, averaged over records
